title: Physics-Informed Functional Link Constrained Framework with Domain Mapping for Solving Bending Analysis of an Exponentially Loaded Perforated Beam
summary: This article presents a novel and comprehensive approach for analyzing bending behavior of the tapered perforated beam under an exponential load. The governing differential equation includes important factors like filling ratio ($α$), number of rows of holes ($N$), tapering parameters ($φ$ and $ψ$), and exponential loading parameter ($γ$), providing a realistic and flexible representation of perforated beam configuration.
